0022600101.text: The Warriors (0-1) host the Grizzlies (1-0) after a road loss, sitting 3rd in the Pacific and 13th in the West, while Memphis is 2nd in the Southwest and 6th in the West. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Brandin Podziemski (back soreness) and Charles Bassey (knee) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions; for Memphis, Cedric Coward (wrist sprain) and Isaiah Stewart (ankle sprain) are also day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Warriors won all three meetings in 2025-26, including a 133-112 win in Memphis on February 25, 2026.
